Indications about the technical data: - All technical data is based on the manufacturer's data at the time of printing.
- Data may vary depending on version, equipment, and country of sale.
- Tolerances apply to all values, especially those relating to performance and weights.
- Consult official CUPRA documentation for the latest and most precise specifications.
Engine specifications: - Electric motor types, battery capacity, and system output may vary by model.
- Power output is typically measured in kW (kilowatts).
- Torque figures are given in Nm (Newton meters).
- High-voltage system specifications are detailed in the owner's documentation.
Dimensions: - Length, width, and height measurements are provided in millimeters.
- Turning circle indicates the smallest space in which the vehicle can turn.
- Luggage capacity is given with and without rear seats folded.
- Ground clearance and approach/departure angles may vary by suspension type and configuration.
